# Vendored KaTeX 0.16.22

Stylesheet and woff2 fonts for KaTeX 0.16.22, taken from the npm
release by `tools/vendor_katex.py`. The version is whatever
`sphinxcontrib-katex` bundles the JavaScript for — the two are
coupled, and a mismatch mis-sizes delimiters silently. Re-run the
script after upgrading the extension.

KaTeX is MIT licensed; `LICENSE` is the text as published.
